plan.summary: This 1-4 block is a short off-camp building phase for a boxer with one 30-minute S&C session each week. Week 1 establishes simple baseline performance on the main lower-body lift so later loading can be adjusted cleanly, and the main program starts in Week 2. With minimal equipment, the plan keeps the session tight: explosive work first, then main strength, then a small amount of upper-body pulling and trunk work.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body strength and simple explosive qualities while keeping the workload easy to recover from alongside boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength work and keep power output sharp with slightly higher intent and tighter quality control.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Turn the earlier strength gains into faster, sharper outputs with lower fatigue and more emphasis on speed.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can on each rep. Land softly and reset between reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if space is tight. Start still and focus on clean takeoff and soft landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low safe box only. Step down each rep and keep every jump crisp.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few gradual sets, then work up to one hard set of 3-5 clean reps with your heaviest safe load. Use this to establish a baseline for future progress. Keep depth consistent and stop if form breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can track your baseline and future progress.

performanceTarget.prompt: Try to beat this baseline later with either more load at the same reps or more reps with the same load while keeping form clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Kettlebell Front Squat

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
